item.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
item.description: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.

item.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
item.description: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.

item.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
item.description: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

item.title: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit
item.description: Some governments moved to confirm chip supply commitments, while others are monitoring the impact on local projects or addressing ongoing investigations.
